_: The works: what a node lets a people raise at a star. The simulation reads every number; the view reads the text.

structures: one row per work: key and name; node (the discovery that unlocks it); the levels it gives (mil, sur, soc); upkeep per tick and cat (the category it is fed under); per (star: one per star; belt: one per belt; absent: two per people, one per star); hardy (a multiplier on decay once abandoned, less is hardier); guns it stands in its star's sky, modern (one more per weapons era beyond the node's), repair (its guns remade while the world is held); dug (raised at every world, never by the pick); watch (light years it sees a fleet in flight); max per people (0 is the usual two). text is its raising ({M} the people, {M} the star); remain what is left of it once abandoned ({M} the makers).
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.

structures.name: archive
structures.text: The {S} raise an archive at {T}, and write down what they are.

structures.name: upload substrate
structures.text: Nothing of the {S} walks {T} any more. The machine they went into runs on, with all of them inside, and they do not come out.

structures.name: ansible net
structures.text: The {S} link {T} to home without delay.

structures.name: arcology
structures.text: The {S} seal a city at {T} against everything outside it.

structures.name: collectors
structures.text: The {S} ring {T} with collectors, and live on its light.

structures.name: defence grid
structures.text: The {S} ring {T} with guns that watch the sky.

structures.name: Dyson swarm
structures.text: The {S} enclose {T} in a swarm of collectors. The star dims from outside.

structures.name: star lifter
structures.text: The {S} set a lifter on {T} and take the star itself for metal.

structures.name: mines
structures.text: The {S} put mines in the belt at {T}.

structures.name: observatory
structures.text: The {S} hang mirrors across {T}, a telescope with a baseline of light-hours. Little moves within forty light years that they do not see.

structures.name: shipyard
structures.text: Yards turn above {T}, building ships for the {S}.

structures.name: silos
structures.text: The {S} dig silos at {T}: nukes on rockets, aimed at the sky.

structures.name: accretion tap
structures.text: The {S} ring the dead star at {T} with a tap and draw on what falls in.
structures.remain: the tap of the {M}, still ringing the dead star
